# Scheduling MCP connectors

11 scheduling connectors for AnythingMCP. Each one gives Claude, ChatGPT, Microsoft Copilot, Cursor and Gemini the MCP tools of one system, on [AnythingMCP Cloud](https://cloud.anythingmcp.com) or on your own server ([run it yourself](../../README.md#run-it-yourself)).

Each connector's page lists its tools with their parameters and how to start without code; the guide links open the setup guide on anythingmcp.com, in seven languages. All scheduling connectors: [anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/scheduling](https://anythingmcp.com/marketplace/category/scheduling).

| Connector | What it does | Tools | Setup guides |
